items.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I started with Harry Reiser and his Clicquot Club Eskimos.

ctx.x: That’s a great story. If it hadn’t been for music, am I right in saying you might have been Doctor Jerome?

Yeah. I finished pre-medicine and went to the University of Alabama Medical School, and finished two years there and went up to Ann Arbor, Michigan to take a summer course that would have gotten me into Ann Arbor, the third year program. And there was a delay because I was from out of state. So I went back to New York to earn some money I needed to go back to school.
